meta.name: broken-link-checker
meta.description: Scans a website to find broken links (404s, 500s). Crawls internal pages, identifies broken outbound links, and reports source pages for easy fixing. Use this when the user asks to "check for broken links", "find 404s", "audit my links", or "is my site healthy".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描网站，找出所有失效链接及对应来源页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你管理网站内容，想快速找到指向失效页面的链接。
copy.tagline_en: Crawl a website and list every broken link with the page it appears on.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a website and want to quickly find links pointing to dead pages.

howto.what: 扫描一个网站，找出打不开的链接（如 404、500 错误）。它会爬取站内页面，识别失效的站外链接，并指出每个坏链出现在哪个页面，方便你修复。扫描后会给出总结和修复建议。
howto.when: 当用户提出 “check for broken links” 、 “find 404s” 、 “audit my links” 等请求，或询问网站是否健康时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查 https://example.com 有没有坏链
say.note: 会启动扫描并汇报坏链情况。

say.text: 找出 https://example.com 上所有 404 页面
say.note: 会扫描并列出断裂的内部和外部链接。

say.text: 我的网站 https://example.com 健康吗？
say.note: 会做全站扫描并报告链接健康状况。

howto.what_en: Scans a website for broken links (e.g. 404s, 500s). It crawls internal pages, detects dead outbound links, and reports which source page each broken link was found on, so you can fix them. After the scan it gives a summary and fix suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to 'check for broken links', 'find 404s', 'audit my links', or asks if their site is healthy.

say_en.note: It will start crawling and report broken links.
It will list the broken internal and external links.
It will scan the whole site and report link health.
